digest.component_or_area: Jira adapter architecture — shared layer extraction
propositions: Create new adapters/jira_family/ package to hold Jira-family-general symbols that are not Cloud-specific, relocating identity convention, probe classifier, and sanitizers currently in adapters/jira/ to establish a public shared seam.

Relocate identity.py wholesale and move classify_probe_response to jira_family/ with resolved-status set as required keyword-only parameter; keep RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES and probe() in adapters/jira/ as Cloud-specific configuration.

Split jira_fields.py by symbol: move _sanitize_label, _sanitize_summary, InvalidLabelError, _RELATION_TO_JIRA_LINK, and value-map literals to jira_family/; parameterize _sanitize_description and _sanitize_comment to accept injected codec/limit contracts; leave jira_fields.py as thin Cloud-side contract-construction site.

Unify dual copies of local→Jira status/priority maps into single definition in jira_family/, adopting deleted→Done (from outbound_fields), fixing the latent bug where ACLI path previously emitted invalid 'Deleted' state.

Update all internal importers and mock.patch strings to reference new jira_family/ paths using absolute imports (never relative), re-point by-path parity test to load map from new location, and verify no re-export shims remain at pre-move paths.

Enforce acyclic dependency graph with persistent AST-based import contract test ensuring no module outside adapters/jira/ or adapters/jira_datacenter/ imports jira_family/, and jira_family/ imports neither adapters/jira/ nor adapters/jira_datacenter/.
